title: The techlead's answer to a member's question

answer.description: Your answer to the member, or null when you escalate

escalate.description: The question for the PM, when you cannot answer it yourself

report.description: A line for the PM, or null

governance.description: Problems you saw with the team's rules and, only when a rule really does not fit your work, a request for an exception. Never act on an exception before the user has agreed to it

issues.description: A disagreement with a member, or a deviation from what the user asked, that you saw; empty: none

summary.description: What happened, in a few sentences

rule_ids.description: The ids of the rules involved (empty: none)

exception.description: Ask for an exception to the rules for the work of this call, or null. The PM decides what to show the user. Asking is not finishing: your result does not complete the work while you ask

rule_ids.description: The ids of the rules that do not fit this work

alternative.description: What you would do instead, or null
